name: Protocol Solari: Escape Room
description:
About This Game

You awaken alone aboard the Aeterna Solis, a massive colony ship drifting in silence.
The crew is gone. The colonists are in cryo sleep.
And an autonomous lockdown protocol is in control.

Protocol Solari is a first-person sci-fi escape room experience set aboard a locked-down starship. Restore failing systems, explore interconnected ship areas, and uncover hidden log entries to piece together what happened.

As the ship’s systems deteriorate, you’ll solve environmental and logic-based puzzles tied directly to critical operating systems. Every solution brings you closer to the truth… and closer to saving the colonists' lives depending on you.

Why did the Solari Protocol activate?
Can you repair the critical systems in time?
And why were you the only one left awake?

Features

  • A fully immersive first-person escape room set aboard a sci-fi colony ship

  • Interconnected puzzles based on critical ship systems

  • Environmental storytelling through hidden logs and terminals

  • Play with a timer for added pressure or without one for a more casual experience

  • Estimated playtime of around 2 hours
short_desc: Awaken alone aboard a drifting colony ship under autonomous lockdown. Restore critical systems, solve interconnected puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Solari Protocol before you and the colonists depending on you are lost to the void.
